ns2:course.label: Microeconomic Principles
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the functions of individual decision-makers, both consumers and producers, within the larger economic system. Primary emphasis on the nature and functions of product markets, the theory of the firm under varying conditions of competition and monopoly, and the role of government in prompting efficiency in the economy. Students receiving credit for ACE 100 may not receive credit for ECON 102.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Students receiving credit for ACE 100 may not receive credit for ECON 102.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one quiz and one lecture section.
